# greybeard

> No more AI slop. An architect skill for coding agents. Before any code is written it decides whether the system should be built at all (warns and stops if it would become AI slop or cost more to run than it is worth), then designs the whole architecture first and fits every user story into it: SOLID, open/closed extension points, Unix philosophy, right-sized, with a committed decision record. Design only; it writes no implementation code.

## Skill

- [SKILL.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alexcpn/greybeard/main/skills/greybeard/SKILL.md): the method (viability gate, constraints, sizing, architecture first, right-sizing, self-review, deliverables)
- [checklist.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alexcpn/greybeard/main/skills/greybeard/references/checklist.md): self-review checklist
- [decision-record.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alexcpn/greybeard/main/skills/greybeard/references/decision-record.md): decisions.json format

## Install

- Claude Code: `/plugin marketplace add alexcpn/greybeard` then `/plugin install greybeard@greybeard`
- Other agents: copy `skills/greybeard/` into the agent's skills folder (e.g. `~/.claude/skills/`, `.agents/skills/`, `.opencode/skills/`)
